```{r}
data_path_sar <-"/Users/wwz/Academic/Thesis_Data/IFLS"
# List all .dta files
file_list_sar <- list.files(path = data_path_sar , pattern = "\\.dta$", full.names = TRUE)

load_sar <- function(filename) {
  read_dta(file.path(data_path_sar, filename))
}
```

# W5 (sar_14)
```{r}
survey_year <- 2015L #year of interview is 2015

# SAR facility statistics
sar_14 %>%
  summarise(
    n=n(),                                    # total number of obs
    n_midwife = sum(x14b1 == 8, na.rm=TRUE),  # number of facilities
    still_open = sum(x07==1, na.rm=TRUE),     # number of facilities operating in subdistrict
    closed_or_moved = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3), na.rm=TRUE),    # facilities moved or left
    have_close_year = sum(!is.na(x08yr)),     # facilities that have year of closure
    have_close_years_ago = sum(!is.na(x08b))  # facilities that have number of year of closure
  )
```
```{r}
# village midwife facilities only (x14b1 == 8)
sar_14 |>
  filter(x14b1 == 8) |>        # village midwife posts
  summarise(
    n                    = n(),
    still_open           = sum(x07 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    closed_or_moved      = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3), na.rm = TRUE),
    # among closed/moved, how many gave a year vs years-ago vs don't-know
    year             = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3) & x08bx == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_ago        = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3) & x08bx == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    dont_know        = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3) & x08bx == 8, na.rm = TRUE),
    have_close_year      = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3) & x08bx == 1 & !is.na(x08yr), na.rm = TRUE),
    have_close_years_ago = sum(x07 %in% c(2,3) & x08bx == 3 & !is.na(x08b),  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```
not many midwife moved from villages

```{r}
names(sar_14)
sar_14_select <- sar_14 |> 
  select(ea,fascode, commid14,          # enumertion area, facility code, community ID 2014
         x02b_cd, x02c_cd, x02d_cd,      # code of kecamatan, kabupaten, province
         x12yr, x12b, x07, x08b, x08yr,  # open, years of operation, still operating, number of years, year of close
         x09, x10, x11,                  # distance to facility from desa office, cost of transfer, time, 
         x14b1) |>            # facility type
  # no community level code, how to link the subdistrict with district? 
  mutate(is_village_midwife = if_else(x14b1 == 8, 1,0)) |>
  filter(!is.na(commid14)) 

# write.csv(sar_14_select,"/Users/wwz/Academic/Thesis_Data/Intermediate/Midwife/sar_14_select.csv")
```

```{r}
sar_14_select |> 
  distinct(ea) |>
  count() # 320 EA 
```

```{r}
sar_14_fac <- sar_14_select |>
  filter(x14b1 == 8) |>  # 8 = village midwife; 7 = private midwife
  mutate(
    open_year_fac  = coalesce(as.integer(x12yr),
                              if_else(!is.na(x12b), survey_year - as.integer(x12b), NA_integer_)),
    # coalesce() returns the first non-missing among its arguments. So it picks x12yr when available; 
    # otherwise it picks the fallback from x12b.
    close_year_fac = case_when(
      x07 == 1 ~ NA_integer_,                         # still operating
      !is.na(x08yr) ~ as.integer(x08yr),              # if closure year exists, then use it 
      !is.na(x08b)  ~ survey_year - as.integer(x08b), # if number of years exists, but exact closure year doesn't exist, use survey to minus the number of years to get the closure year
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_),      
    open_year_fac  = if_else(open_year_fac  >= 1989 & open_year_fac  <= 2015, open_year_fac,  NA_integer_),
    close_year_fac = if_else(is.na(close_year_fac) | (close_year_fac >= 1989 & close_year_fac <= 2015),
                             close_year_fac, NA_integer_)
  ) |>
  group_by(commid14) |>
  summarise(
    start_year_sar = suppressWarnings(min(open_year_fac, na.rm = TRUE)),
    present_sar    = as.integer(any(x07 ==1 |
                                      !is.na(open_year_fac) &           # still operating
                                      open_year_fac <= survey_year &  # operating within survey year
                                      (is.na(close_year_fac) | close_year_fac >= survey_year))) # no closure year or closure year is greater than the survey year 
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(start_year_sar = ifelse(is.infinite(start_year_sar), NA, start_year_sar))

sar_14_fac
```

# PKK_14
```{r}
pkk_14_select <- 
  pkk_14 |> 
  filter(!is.na(commid14)) |>
  select(commid14, ea, 
         j10a,j10a1, # is there village midwife, ever been a village midwife
         j10a2bln, j10a2th, # month, year of leaving
         j10b, # number of village midwife 
         j10c, # in what years the first village midwife began 
         j10d, # years of practice in the village; survey year - years = start_year
         j10e # type of support village midwife provide
         )
pkk_14_select <- 
  pkk_14_select |> 
  mutate(midwife_present = as.integer(if_else(j10a == 1, 1, 0)),
         star_year_pkk = if_else(as.integer(j10c) >= 1989 & as.integer(j10c) <= 2015, j10c, NA_integer_))
pkk_14_select

pkk_14_select$j10c |> as.integer(as.character()) |> summary() # earliest midwife is 1969???; latest is 2014
sum(as.integer(pkk_14_select$midwife_present))/320 # 0.740625 of the communities have midwives

# write.csv(pkk_14_select,"/Users/wwz/Academic/Thesis_Data/Intermediate/Midwife/pkk_14_select.csv")

```


```{r}
# Merge SAR and PKK (need to double-check, the numbers cannot match)
sar_pkk_14 <- 
  full_join(sar_14_fac, pkk_14_select, by = "commid14") |>
  relocate(star_year_pkk, .before = 03)
sar_pkk_14
```

```{r}
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
```
